title: The Network’s enforcer becomes ECW’s final champion
summary: Cyrus presents the Network as an outside authority trying to control ECW. Rhino supplies its physical force, overwhelming opponents on his way to both singles championships.

chapters.title: Rhino wins the Television title
chapters.result: Rhino defeats Tajiri for the championship.
chapters.context: The Network’s enforcer gains a belt after Tajiri’s break with the group.

chapters.title: Rhino denies Van Dam’s return to the title
chapters.result: Rhino defeats Van Dam to retain the Television championship.
chapters.context: The former long-reigning champion fails to reclaim the belt he had vacated through injury.

chapters.title: Rhino takes Sandman’s newly won world title
chapters.result: Rhino defeats Sandman in an impromptu championship match.
chapters.context: Already Television champion, Rhino becomes the original ECW’s last world champion. The Network is an on-screen faction, not a literal account of TNN management.
